opportunities.name: Meditate hybrid survivor
opportunities.objective: Test meditate hybrid survivor against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Meditate heals with 1.0 AP across four seconds, increased at low health; Nashor and Gunblade preserve attack damage while AP tests survival through the channel. Terminus supports mixed ordinary attacks, but W cannot deal damage and E's true damage still benefits AD.
opportunities.requiredState: Use W after the initial half-second damage-reduction window is relevant.
opportunities.failure: Interruptions or lost attacking time outweigh extra healing.
opportunities.test: Measure healing at fixed missing health and subsequent five-second attack damage.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Meditate is not an AP damage spell; Q has no documented AP ratio.

opportunities.name: Wuju health-to-AD reset
opportunities.objective: Test wuju health-to-ad reset against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Wuju Style adds 0.35 AD[source modifier] true damage per attack; Bloodmail converts item health to AD while Titanic supports physical attacks. Hexplate synchronizes with Highlander for an eight-second attack window, then champion takedowns reduce basic cooldowns by 70%.
opportunities.requiredState: Enter with R and survive to an actual first takedown.
opportunities.failure: Lower attack speed and kiting can prevent the reset the build depends on.
opportunities.test: Compare E true damage and time to first kill with equal targets.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: No free Highlander extension or cooldown refund without champion takedowns.

ruledOut.reason: Meditate is not an AP damage spell; Q has no documented AP ratio.

unknowns: Controlled current-patch proc testing remains necessary; source helper/statFormula expressions are evidence, not confirmed runtime behavior.

builds.name: Meditate hybrid survivor
builds.summary: Test meditate hybrid survivor against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test meditate hybrid survivor against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Meditate heals with 1.0 AP across four seconds, increased at low health; Nashor and Gunblade preserve attack damage while AP tests survival through the channel. Terminus supports mixed ordinary attacks, but W cannot deal damage and E's true damage still benefits AD.
testPlan: Required state: Use W after the initial half-second damage-reduction window is relevant.
Measure healing at fixed missing health and subsequent five-second attack damage.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Interruptions or lost attacking time outweigh extra healing.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Meditate is not an AP damage spell; Q has no documented AP ratio.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Hextech Gunblade, Riftmaker, Spirit Visage, Terminus, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula: Every [4]th Attack, Master Yi strikes twice. The second Attack deals [(0.5) × AD] physical damage.

Master Yi becomes Untargetable and teleports to rapidly strike enemies near his target, dealing [20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 + (0.7) × AD] physical damage to all enemies hit after [4] hits. 

This Ability can strike the same enemy repeatedly if there are no other targets, dealing [25]% damage for subsequent hits ([((20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 + (0.7) × AD)) × (0.25)]), for a maximum single target total of [(20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 + (0.7) × AD) × ((1 + (0.25) × ((-1 + 4))))] physical damage.

Master Yi channels, restoring [120 / 200 / 280 / 360 / 440 + (1) × AP] Health over [4] seconds. This healing is increased by up to [100]% based on Master Yi's missing Health.

While channeling and for [0.5] seconds afterwards, he takes [(0.45 / 0.475 / 0.5 / 0.525 / 0.55 + 0.25 / 0.225 / 0.2 / 0.175 / 0.15)] reduced damage, decreased to [(0.45 / 0.475 / 0.5 / 0.525 / 0.55) × 100]% after the first [0.5] seconds.
Master Yi's Attacks deal an additional [20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40 + (0.35) × AD[statFormula=2]] true damage for [5] seconds.

Passive: Champion takedowns reduce the remaining Cooldown of Master Yi's basic Abilities by [70]%.

Active: Master Yi enters a trance, gaining [40 / 50 / 60]% Move Speed, [25 / 45 / 65]% Attack Speed, and immunity to Slows for [7] seconds. Champion takedowns extend the duration of this Ability by [7] seconds.
